name: Runway
problem: Money leaves a small business in dozens of small pieces, and nobody can say at a glance how long the cash lasts.
built: A web rebuild of the original tool: every outgoing amount in one ledger, a burn line, and the number of days left at the current rate.
changed: In progress. The web version is being rebuilt in this stack; the number that matters is the days-left figure on the first screen.

name: Mail Room
problem: An inbox fills faster than one person can file it, and the useful messages hide between the rest.
built: A native Mac app that reads the inbox and sorts each message into a bucket, so the person only reads what is left.
changed: Mail Room stays native. This page is the case study; a short video and a link to the app follow when they are ready.

name: Company Log
oneLiner: Every post from a company's socials, one place.
problem: Following what a company says means opening four apps and scrolling four feeds.
built: Paste a company's social links; a scheduled worker collects every post into one feed. The scraper runs on a GitHub Actions cron and writes to Supabase.
changed: In progress. The scraper is the long pole; official APIs first, scraping as the fallback.

name: This site
problem: A portfolio usually shows one layout. Ten were drawn, and choosing one throws away nine.
built: One JSON file describes every project. Each layout is a renderer over that file, so views can be added without touching the data. The design system lives in the same repo.
changed: Live. One view so far; the switcher that lets a visitor flip between them is the next piece.
